content: Ananya Nair contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to request a 15-day payment extension for her health policy's outstanding premium and reinstatement fee due to financial constraints. Sunita Agarwal approved a one-time 15-day extension, applied an additional ₹500 late fee, and provided an updated invoice showing a total due of ₹16,000 with a new due date of 25/10/2024.

action_items: Pay the total amount due of ₹16,000 by 25/10/2024
